overall_reason: Untinted greys carry the export window and the toast, with one muted green dot for 'Export complete', but the text spreads over five greys and the toast uses a border with a shadow.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES finds five text levels and T-SURFACE-LADDER finds a border plus shadow on the toast and two shadow recipes; the green is held to the one success state.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.after: Three text levels: ink, secondary, tertiary.
findings.why: Near-duplicate greys show the scale was not fixed.

findings.title: A card has a border or a shadow
findings.evidence: The toast shadow is rgba(0,0,0,0.11) 0 3px 12px with a 1px #e8e8e8 ring; the window uses a second recipe, rgba(0,0,0,0.043) 0 4px 14px. The palette table counts 1 border plus shadow and 2 shadow recipes.
findings.before: A border plus a shadow on the toast, and a different shadow on the window.
findings.after: The toast with a shadow alone, from one shadow recipe.
findings.why: Two edge treatments on one floating surface make it heavier than its message.

strengths: The green dot is the only hue and marks the one completed state.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
